# Quality vs the BF16 original (generated by analysis/quality.py; do not edit)

Reference: **q1_h200_bf16_fp8/20261122T074352Z:bf16_ref** (BF16 weights, BF16 KV). Greedy decoding everywhere. GSM8K = test[:250] with OpenRelay's prompt and scoring; MMLU-Pro = our 200-item set; agreement = 400 public-text prompts, 192-token greedy continuations, identical text vs BF16. Δ = config minus BF16 on the same items, paired 95% interval; b/c = items lost / gained vs BF16; p = exact McNemar. 250 items give roughly ±2-3 points of sampling noise on accuracy.
